visualCharacteristics: A section title over a grid of white, shadowed plan cards on the brand gradient band, each with an optional ribbon, plan name, icon USP list, price and primary/outline CTA buttons.
contentPattern: A head row with the h2 section title, then one row per plan: optional em-only ribbon paragraph, h3 plan name, a ul of USPs (each starting with an :icon:, :close: = not included), optional price/promo paragraphs, an optional picture (media variant), and CTA paragraphs (strong link = primary, em link = outline).
usage: Use to compare subscription plans or packages side by side with their features, price and order buttons.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any plan or package comparison; choose tv, internet or media for the matching card layout instead of building a new pricing block.
